env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Turns on Google sign-in. In Google Cloud Console create an OAuth client of type 'Web application', add this site's address under 'Authorized JavaScript origins', and paste its Client ID here. No client secret is needed. Leave blank to run guest-only.

env.name: GLOBAL_ADMIN_EMAILS
env.description: Your Google account email (comma-separated for several). These accounts get the Admin tab: teams, feedback and settings. You can add more admins later inside the app. Without this, nobody can open the Admin tab.

env.name: TBA_API_KEY
env.description: Needed to load events and matches. Get a free 'Read API Key' at thebluealliance.com/account. Without it the app opens but has no events to show.

env.name: REQUIRE_HTTPS
env.description: Reject plain-HTTP requests. Safe to leave on: the app always sits behind the platform's HTTPS proxy.
